users.title: Users
users.caption: User directory
users.col.name: Name
users.empty.title: No users yet
users.empty.description: Invite the first person to get started.
invite.title: Invite user
invite.description: We will send a single-use link, valid for 72 hours, to the given email.
users.tabs.label: User sections
team.caption: People you manage
team.empty.title: There is nobody to manage
team.empty.description: People on your team will appear here.
deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.description: This action is irreversible: the person will no longer be able to sign in. Their direct reports will move to their manager.
rank.title: Change rank
rank.description: Choose the new rank for {{name}}. This is a sensitive action: you may be asked to confirm your identity.
rank.label: New rank
rank.demoteWarning: Lowering the rank removes the roles of {{name}} that exceed the new ceiling and closes their sessions. If they are left with no role, the new rank's template role is assigned.
rank.reason.label: Reason
rank.reason.helpRequired: Required when raising a rank. It is kept in the audit trail and is not sent by email.
rank.reason.helpOptional: Optional when lowering a rank. It is kept in the audit trail and is not sent by email.
rank.result.description: Result of the rank change for {{name}}.
rank.result.templateSkipped: {{name}} was left without any role: the template of the new rank was not assigned because it includes permissions you do not have. Ask someone who has them to assign a role.
rank.result.shares.title: Shares to review ({{count}})
rank.result.shares.description: {{name}} granted these accesses and they were not revoked: review them and remove the ones that no longer apply.
rank.result.shares.noDetail: You do not have permission to see the details of these shares; ask someone who manages the vault to review them.
transfer.title: Transfer manager
transfer.description: Choose who will be {{name}}'s manager. They must have a higher rank than the person.
transfer.empty: No available person matches the search.
invitations.caption: Pending invitations
invitations.empty.title: There are no pending invitations
invitations.empty.description: Invitations you send that have not been accepted will appear here.
invite.rolesHelp: Optional. The person will receive the permissions of the roles you choose.
invite.managerHelp: Optional. If you choose no one, it will be you. Only active people in your team with a higher rank than the invitee are listed.
invite.link.option: Show the invitation link so I can share it myself
invite.link.optionHelp: The email is still sent. The link is shown only once, in the next step, and you may be asked to confirm your identity.
link.title: Invitation link
link.description: Share this link with {{email}} through a channel you trust.
link.heading: Invitation created for {{email}}.
link.emailSent: The email was sent to {{email}}. You can also share the link yourself.
link.emailFailed: The email could not be sent. Share this link through another channel.
link.warning: This link is shown only once and cannot be viewed again; to see it again you must resend the invitation. Anyone who has it can accept the invitation.
invitations.resendWithLinkLabel: Resend the invitation to {{email}} and show the link
access.title: Roles and permissions for {{name}}
access.description: Assign roles and special permissions. This is a sensitive action: you may be asked to confirm your identity.
access.roles.help: The roles this person will have. Saving replaces the current ones; you can only grant permissions you already have.
access.roles.empty: There are no roles to assign.
access.special.help: Individual permissions added on top of their roles, as far as their rank allows. If you select none, all are removed.
access.special.helpLimits: Only the permissions that the person's rank allows and that you hold are offered.
access.special.catalogError: We could not check which permissions this rank allows; the server will validate on save.
access.special.empty: There are no permissions that can be assigned to this rank.
